description: This is a test class for the LeaveTypeDao in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations, querying, and filtering of LeaveType entities.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the LeaveTypeDao's functionality in handling LeaveType entities in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates DAO instance, and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the leave type list and compares with expected data load from fixtures.

methods.name: _getLeaveTypeObjectWithValues
methods.description: Creates a LeaveType object with preset values for use in save tests.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Verifies that saving a LeaveType returns a LeaveType object with an assigned ID.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeCheckSavedType
methods.description: Checks that the saved LeaveType has correct properties in the database.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests deletion (soft delete) of leave types by ID and verifies the returned count.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Ensures that deleted LeaveType entries are marked as deleted.

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies that getDeletedLeaveTypeList returns the correct number and IDs of deleted leave types.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Checks all objects in the deleted leave type list are of type LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of deleted leave types.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Ensures the deleted leave types do not contain certain IDs and names.

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Checks specific IDs and names in the ordered deleted leave type list.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests undeleting (restoring) leave types by ID and checks the returned object.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeValues
methods.description: Verifies that the undeleted LeaveType has isDeleted() returning false.

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Checks that undeleting a leave type updates total list count appropriately.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameType
methods.description: Tests retrieving LeaveType by valid and invalid names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameValues
methods.description: Verifies the ID and name of a LeaveType fetched by name.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectType
methods.description: Tests fetching LeaveType objects by ID, including deleted ones.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectWrongArgument
methods.description: Checks behavior when fetching LeaveType with invalid ID (zero).

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdValues
methods.description: Checks the properties of the LeaveType object retrieved by ID.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Ensures all items in the leave type list are instances of LeaveType.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of leave types fetched.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Checks that certain IDs and names are not in the leave type list.

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Checks specific leave types' IDs and names in order.

methods.name: _compareLeaveTypes
methods.description: Helper method to compare two lists of LeaveType objects.

methods.name: _compareLeaveType
methods.description: Helper method to compare individual LeaveType objects.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Tests that the count of leave types matching search criteria is as expected.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveType
methods.description: Tests full search functionality, checking correct leave types returned.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeSearchByName
methods.description: Tests search filtering by leave type name.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveTypeWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies that search respects limit parameter.
